description: This walk follows a section of the England Coast Path from Newbiggin By The Sea to Cresswell. The route runs for just over 4 miles, following a fairly flat path north from the car park at Newbiggin. On the way you will pass pretty beaches, sand dunes, interesting rock formations and the neighbouring village of Lynemouth. There's also splendid coastal views with lots of seabirds to look out for too. In Cresswell you can visit the Cresswell Pond Nature Reserve where there's a pretty pond with lots more wildlife to see. Continue north along the path and you could visit the delightful villages of Amble and Warkworth. See the Cresswell to Amble and Warkworth Walk for more details.
